offers_products.reason: Main offerings are exchange-traded products (ETFs/ETPs), investment funds and tokenized fund products.

offers_services.reason: Asset management for investors, plus farmland investment management via Ceres and onchain infrastructure services.

sells_to_consumers.reason: ETFs are bought by individual investors, directly or through advisers and brokerage platforms.

sells_to_organizations.reason: Institutions, advisers, developers and financial innovators use its ETPs, platforms and infrastructure.

recurring_revenue.reason: Revenue is mostly ongoing management fees charged on ETP assets under management.

cyclical_demand.reason: Fee revenue depends on market levels and investor flows, which fall in downturns; investors can easily redeem.

big_ticket.reason: Investors buy ETF shares in small, frequent amounts and pay ongoing fees.

people_delivered.reason: Customers pay for investment products and technology platforms, not mainly for staff time.

large_customers.reason: Mix of retail investors, advisers and institutions; no single large enterprise or government focus.

asset_heavy.reason: Asset manager with fund products and software; it needs no plants or fleets (Ceres manages farmland for clients).
